How It Works

Experience the magic of Ventura with a simple, straightforward process designed for your celebration.

Pick & Play

Choose from our curated list of activities. Whether it's a high-stakes escape room or a creative cupcake decorating session, we've got the perfect adventure for your birthday.

Pay After

Enjoy your party without the stress. We handle all the planning and coordination, so you can focus on the fun. Pay only after the celebration is over.

Fully adjustable

All activities and birthday events can be changed to suit the celebration desires. Each birthday is meticulously designed to maximise YOUR enjoyment.
